record.field: # NSSF Act 2013 Tier I/II employee contribution rates (in force since # February 2025): 6% of pensionable pay, split between Tier I (pay up to # the Lower Earnings Limit) and Tier II (pay between the Lower and Upper # Earnings Limits). The employer matches this amount separately. tier_1_limit = 8000.0 tier_2_limit = 72000.0 pensionable_pay = min(categories.GROSS, tier_2_limit) tier_1 = min(pensionable_pay, tier_1_limit) * 0.06 tier_2 = max(pensionable_pay - tier_1_limit, 0.0) * 0.06 result = -(tier_1 + tier_2)

Statutory employee NSSF contribution: 6% of pensionable pay across Tier I (first KES 8,000) and Tier II (KES 8,001-72,000), per the NSSF Act 2013 rates in force since February 2025. The employer remits a matching amount.
# Social Health Insurance Fund (SHIF) replaced NHIF from October 2024: # 2.75% of gross pay, subject to a minimum monthly contribution of KES 300. result = -max(categories.GROSS * 0.0275, 300.0)
Social Health Insurance Fund contribution: 2.75% of gross pay, minimum KES 300/month (replaces NHIF from October 2024).
# Affordable Housing Act 2024: employee contributes 1.5% of gross pay; the # employer remits a matching 1.5% (not deducted from the employee). result = -(categories.GROSS * 0.015)
Affordable Housing Levy: employee contributes 1.5% of gross pay. The employer matches with an equal 1.5%, remitted but not deducted from the employee's pay.

# Pay As You Earn, computed on taxable pay (gross less the statutory # NSSF/SHIF/AHL contributions, which are all tax-deductible) using the # graduated monthly bands from the Finance Act 2023 (in force since # 1 July 2023), less the monthly personal relief of KES 2,400. taxable_pay = categories.GROSS + categories.NSSF + categories.SHIF + categories.AHL bands = [ (24000.0, 0.10), (8333.0, 0.25), (467667.0, 0.30), (300000.0, 0.325), (float('inf'), 0.35), ] remaining = max(taxable_pay, 0.0) tax = 0.0 for width, rate in bands: if remaining <= 0: break slice_amount = min(remaining, width) tax += slice_amount * rate remaining -= slice_amount personal_relief = 2400.0 result = -max(tax - personal_relief, 0.0)
Income tax computed on taxable pay (gross less NSSF/SHIF/AHL) using the Finance Act 2023 graduated bands — 10% / 25% / 30% / 32.5% / 35% — less the KES 2,400 monthly personal relief.

Kenyan statutory payroll: NSSF (Tier I/II), SHIF, Affordable Housing Levy and PAYE on top of the base BASIC/GROSS/NET rules. Built-in rates: NSSF 6% (tier-capped), SHIF 2.75% (min KES 300), AHL 1.5%, PAYE per the Finance Act 2023 bands with the KES 2,400 personal relief. Review rates periodically — Kenyan statutory rates change with Finance Acts and NSSF Act phase-ins.
